clubs.name: Robotics Club
clubs.description: Design, build, and program robots for district and regional competitions. No experience needed — we teach everything from wiring to coding.
clubs.join: Show up to any meeting or email the sponsor for the team interest form.

clubs.name: Art Club
clubs.description: Open studio time for drawing, painting, and mixed media. We also design backdrops for school plays and run the spring art show.
clubs.join: Just come to a meeting — all skill levels welcome. Bring ideas; supplies are provided.

clubs.name: National Honor Society
clubs.description: Service organization for students who meet GPA and character requirements. Members log volunteer hours through school-approved projects.
clubs.join: Applications open each spring. Check the official chapter page for eligibility and deadlines.

clubs.name: Debate Team
clubs.description: Competitive argumentation and public speaking. We travel to local tournaments in policy and Lincoln-Douglas debate.
clubs.join: Attend the fall interest meeting listed in morning announcements, or email the sponsor.

clubs.name: Coding Club
clubs.description: Hands-on coding projects in Python and JavaScript, plus prep for the district hackathon. Beginners are matched with a mentor.
clubs.join: Drop in any Thursday. Bring a charged laptop if you have one; lab computers are available.

clubs.name: Student Council
clubs.description: Plans dances, spirit weeks, and service drives, and represents student voice to administration. Elections each spring; appointed positions in fall.
clubs.join: Pick up an election or appointment packet from Room 1005, or talk to any officer.

clubs.name: Environmental Club
clubs.description: Runs the school recycling program, tends the courtyard garden, and organizes campus clean-up days.
clubs.join: Come to Friday morning meetings or sign up at the club fair in the fall.

clubs.name: Theater Troupe
clubs.description: Fall play and spring musical plus crew roles in lights, sound, sets, and costumes. You do not have to act to join.
clubs.join: Auditions are announced each season; crew sign-ups are open to everyone at the first meeting.

clubs.name: Math Team
clubs.description: Problem-solving practice for UIL and regional math competitions. Weekly puzzles, past exams, and snacks.
clubs.join: Open enrollment — just show up. Talk to your math teacher if you want a referral.

clubs.name: Photography Club
clubs.description: Photo walks, editing workshops, and the campus photo archive. Phones welcome — no camera required.
clubs.join: Check the schedule posted outside Room 1308 for the next meeting date.
